row_statement: Conjecture 4 of Gatzweiler and Krattenthaler (Conjecture 1.3 in Gatzweiler, Levican-Santibanez and Yoshida: for positive integers m >= n and non-negative integers a_1,...,a_n, if prod (1-q^{m+i})^{a_i} / prod (1-q^i)^{a_i} is a polynomial in q then its coefficients are non-negative) is false: for n = 38, m = 58, a_6 = a_9 = a_18 = a_38 = 1, a_32 = 2 and all other a_i = 0 the quotient is an integer polynomial of degree 348 with coefficient -1 at q^67. Stanton's original symmetric conjecture and Gatzweiler-Krattenthaler's symmetric Conjecture 3 are not affected.

caveats: Not minimal: Opus found a smaller counterexample in about 17 seconds (n = 20, m = 22, a_3 = a_14 = a_18 = a_20 = 1, coefficient -1 at q^25), not in Lean.
The sources tested only two symmetric families and Stanton's length-17 vector; the source proves the conjecture for m > 2n*floor(n/2) - 2, and the witness is outside that range.
The area is very active (two proofs of the authors' other conjecture appeared in the week of 2026-11-11 to 11-19); a public counterexample could appear at any time. Checked as of 2026-11-20.
